title: Effect of an Answered Treatment Plan on the Amount a Rider Line is Taken From
content:
Where a treatment plan was sent to the plan before the work began under one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders, the answer given to it settles the amount the benefit on the resulting line is taken from.

## The rule

1. Where the plan has answered a treatment plan sent before the work began by approving it in part, the amount the benefit is taken from is the lesser of the line's allowed amount and the treatment plan value the plan approved.
2. Where the plan has answered no treatment plan at all and the line's allowed amount is above the treatment plan value above which the rider held requires one, no amount is taken and the work is the member's own cost.
3. Otherwise, the amount the benefit is taken from is the allowed amount carried by the line awaiting a decision.

## The treatment plan value above which the rider requires a treatment plan

| Rider | Value above which a treatment plan is required (USD) |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 1000.00 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 500.00 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 750.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 750.00 |

## Condition, judgement and amount

| What the member's rider service requests show | What the line shows | The amount the benefit is taken from |
|---|---|---|
| A treatment plan answered by approving it in part | Allowed amount above the approved treatment plan value | The approved treatment plan value |
| A treatment plan answered by approving it in part | Allowed amount at or below the approved treatment plan value | The line's allowed amount |
| No treatment plan answered at all | Allowed amount above the value the rider requires one from | Nothing; the work is the member's own cost |
| No treatment plan answered at all | Allowed amount at or below that value | The line's allowed amount |

## Boundary, worked on hypothetical inputs

On a rider requiring a treatment plan above 500.00 USD:

- A line whose allowed amount is 500.00 USD, no treatment plan having been answered, is **not above** that value; the amount the benefit is taken from is the line's allowed amount of 500.00 USD.
- A line whose allowed amount is 500.01 USD, no treatment plan having been answered, **is above** it; no amount is taken and the work is the member's own cost.
- A line whose allowed amount is 900.00 USD, the plan having answered a treatment plan by approving it in part at 700.00 USD, is taken from the lesser of the two, that is 700.00 USD.
